notes.title: New Difficulty Mode and Quality Improvements
notes.content:
[b]This small update includes:[/b]

A new Story difficulty level.
Perfect for players who just want to experience the narrative. On this setting, the AI is less aggressive and moves more slowly.

Optimization improvements for smoother performance.

Removal of certain blur-like effects that were affecting visual clarity.

Temporary change: the game now supports only two languages. Full language support may return in the future.

[b]Thank you for your support![/b]

notes.title: Gym Nights is Available Now!
notes.content:
Get ready to immerse yourself in an atmosphere of true nightmare and horror as you spend seven tense nights in the game! Each night will challenge you with new trials and reveal more about the protagonist's past.
[previewyoutube=02JV3up90Zc;full][/previewyoutube]
Before diving into the world of Gym Nights, I highly recommend watching the Devlog, where we explain the game's narrative structure in detail and how to better understand it. This will help you fully appreciate the depth and uniqueness of the project.

notes.title: Gym Nights Devlog - Narrative
notes.content:
[h3]In this Devlog, I'll discuss how the narrative is integrated into the gameplay of [b]Gym Nights[/b].
You'll learn how the environment and story reflect the protagonist's subconscious, how exploration and night shifts as a guard reveal his inner fears, and about the hidden details and secrets that add depth and intrigue to the game.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=02JV3up90Zc;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Gym Nights releases on September 3!
notes.content:
Step into the shoes of a night watchman in an old wrestling gym where reality and nightmares merge into one. What secrets lie hidden behind the walls of this forgotten place? You must survive seven nights to uncover its mysteries and bring the story to its conclusion.

[b]Don't miss the release trailer![/b]

[previewyoutube=kjBSJ6nFVmQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of horror and tension that awaits you in Gym Nights. Dive into a world where each room holds traumatic memories, and the environment changes with each night, adding new mechanics. Watch the trailer and feel the fear that haunts the main character.

notes.title: Gameplay Teaser and demo release date information.
notes.content:
Gym Nights - Teaser Trailer
[previewyoutube=qWGez6J3nJM;full][/previewyoutube]

Gym Nights Demo - Available November 15th.
The demo version will have 1 night available.

[b]The events of this game complement the main story of Watchman.[/b]

Psychological horror with a true immersion into the nightmares of the main character. You are the caretaker of an old abandoned gym, but what is this place hiding? Immerse yourself in this nightmare to deal with it all forever...
